title: Content
subtitle: Views, engagement, clicks and generated leads from your connected networks.
youtubeEarlySignals: I’m checking the first signals now. Publish a few more videos so I can see which patterns hold.
youtubeIdeas: I found {count} idea(s) based on what already works on your channel.
youtubeEnoughData: There is enough YouTube data to suggest new ideas. Generate them with Creator Falco.
overviewConnected: Your connected networks have {views} total views across {posts} post(s).
overviewDisconnected: Connect a social network to see your content performance.
instagramNotProfessional: This Instagram account is personal. Switch it to Business or Creator and try again.
instagramError: Instagram connection failed. Try again in a moment.
youtubeNoChannel: No YouTube channel is associated with this Google account. Sign in with the account that owns the channel.
youtubeNoRefreshToken: Google did not return permanent access. Try connecting again, then reconnect Minaly if needed.
youtubeError: YouTube connection failed. Try again in a moment.
youtubeState: I’m checking the signals from your YouTube channel.
formatHelp: YouTube does not provide an official Short indicator through its API. Videos up to 2 minutes are classified as Shorts. A long video published in short format may be classified incorrectly.
instagramCtrHelp: Instagram provides no outbound click data for an organic post. This metric is empty by design.
instagramLeadsHelp: A post needs to be linked manually to attribute a lead. This metric stays at 0 for now.
youtubeRetentionHelp: Average share of each video watched by viewers for the selected period and format. YouTube uses this signal when it recommends videos.

youtube.topVideosHelp: Videos ranked by views since you connected YouTube.
youtube.topVideosSub: Ranked by views and {format} since connection.
youtube.noVideosHelp: Connect your YouTube channel above to see your videos.
youtube.noPeriodHelp: Choose All to see the full history.
youtube.title: Title
youtube.hooksTitle: What gets people to click and watch
youtube.enoughData: Based on {count} video{plural} with enough data
youtube.retentionHelp: Analysis starts after a video reaches {views} views. We fetch curves for your most-viewed videos at each sync.
youtube.medianDropOffHelp: The point where half your audience has left, measured on each video's retention curve. We use the median so one video that drops at 5 seconds does not skew the result.
youtube.below30: Under 30 s: the hook is losing viewers, not the rest of the video.
youtube.afterHook: After the hook: check where the pace drops.
youtube.retention30Help: Share of viewers still watching after 30 seconds. This is where the hook plays out. Videos shorter than 30 seconds are excluded.
youtube.hookGap: {value} retention gap at 30 s between the two. See how you open "{title}" and use the same structure.
youtube.trafficHelp: YouTube breakdown across your most-viewed videos. Search means viewers found you on purpose. Suggested videos are recommended by YouTube.
youtube.searchTerms: What people search to find you
youtube.searchHelp: These YouTube queries brought viewers to your videos. Use them to choose your next topic.
youtube.importedHelp: Average share watched, retrieved from YouTube for videos with more than 100 views.
youtube.importedReady: Your videos are analyzed. We fetch detailed curves at the next YouTube refresh. The figures above are ready for format comparisons.

explanations.retention: Average share of the video watched. YouTube uses it with watch time when deciding whether to recommend a video. Color compares this video with the median of your other videos in the same format.
explanations.watchTime: Total watch time accumulated on this video, in minutes.
explanations.subscribers: Subscribers gained minus subscribers lost, generated directly by this video and reported by YouTube.
explanations.bookings: Booked calls attributed to this video. Enter them manually because YouTube does not expose this data.
explanations.dealsClosed: Calls from this video that resulted in a sale. Enter them manually.

table.topPostsHelp: Ranking of your posts, reels, and carousels by total interactions since connecting your Instagram account.
table.topPostsSubtitle: Ranked by interactions across all posts since connection.
table.noPostsHelp: Connect your Instagram account above to see your posts.
table.noPostsPeriodHelp: Choose All to see the full history.
table.title: Title
table.followersHelp: New followers generated by this post.

detail.instagramNotice: Outbound clicks on an organic post cannot be measured through the Instagram API, so they do not appear here.
detail.youtubeNotice: YouTube does not expose booking data. Enter it here for this video.
